20261121-math-g06-1.material: [E6 Baaritaanka Xisaabta (Sare)] Dhibaatada baaritaanka adag iyadoo la adeegsanayo Xisaabinta jajabyada iyo jajabyada tobanle ah, saami, boqolleyda, goobo iyo mug, celcelis. Wadarta saddex lambar oo dabiici ah oo isxiga waa $3S$, taranka kan ugu yar iyo kan ugu weyn oo lagu daray $1$ wuxuu le'eg yahay $T^2$. Marka $S = 15$, keebaa ugu weyn saddexdan?

20261121-math-g06-1.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabada 1: Isagoo lambarrada loo qaadanayo $n-1, n, n+1$, wadartu waa $3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.

20261122-math-g06-1.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabada 1: Dib u habaynta isla'egtu waxay bixinaysaa $A = 24 - 2B$.
